175dd3.conditions: useFixedOrder=false (default), so IndicesSyncer::recvAndUnpack probes MPI_ANY_SOURCE tag 345; middle ranks 1,2 can take neighbours' messages in either order
175dd3.reasoning: The only order-dependent matching is the MPI_Probe(MPI_ANY_SOURCE,345) in dune-common indicessyncer.hh:1028 (the repartition probe at repartition.hh:1646 is order-independent: owners are sorted by global index). Each sync gets exactly one message per neighbour, sends are Issend and are waited on, and levels are separated by allreduces, so no cross-level or cross-tag mismatch, no deadlock. Arrival order only permutes the local numbers that numberer() gives to newly discovered copy indices, which are appended after all existing ones. Copy rows become Dirichlet identity rows, aggregation skips copy vertices, remote lists and redistribution are ordered by global index. In this 1D strip partition no smoothed owner row couples to new copies from two different neighbours, so the SSOR and matvec sums keep the same order and the results do not change.
